decisions.reason: The accepted option does affect success-modal follow-up controls, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering the manual random-referral finalization button and suppression of automatic follow-up prompts.
The separate post-mint tipping control does not change the deferred Transak fiat conversion or automatic NFT-mint flow.
The success-modal transaction controls do not change wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access for fiat buyers.
Making tip and random-referral actions separate manual transactions does not alter which mint transactions are authoritatively recorded or counted.
The accepted post-success tipping UX does not change the connected-wallet USDC payment and mint execution behavior.
The accepted post-mint controls do not change ETH swap, output-target, shortfall, or mint behavior.
The source changes how an optional tip is submitted, not the mandatory $15 primary-mint allocation.
The client accepted success-modal controls but did not request any corresponding FAQ copy change.
A separate optional tip transaction after minting does not change disclosure or selection of primary payment methods.
The source concerns optional tip and referral-finalization prompts, not the return of excess ETH payment value.
The accepted success-modal interaction does not entail a change to About-page content.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY stating that no-referral commissions count and become visible only after the separate random-referral finalization transaction completes.
